Many here blackpill about leaving NATO, that President Trump is not serious about it, he's doing nothing.  We've told you he's got a plan.  Be patient.  Let the man cook.

Well I give you exhibit "A".  Let's go back to 1951.  That's when we signed the agreement on Greenland with Denmark.  It had a key phrase in it "so long as NATO, notwithstanding....".  If we left NATO before securing our interests in Greenland, Greenland would be open for anything.  Our agreement if we left NATO first before securing another agreement would be null because that agreement, signed in 1951, was under NATO auspices and relies on us being a member of it for validity.

We were never going to "buy" Greenland.  That's just President Trump doing his thing.  If you haven't read "Art of The Deal" then you wouldn't understand his tactics here. Anyway, now that he's secured and agreement for us to basically control Greenland in perpetuity OUTSIDE NATO, that gives us the ability to finally unhitch our horse from that sinking ship.  Sec State Rubio had a great comment about it a few months ago.  Basically saying we need to re-evaluate our relationship with NATO.  He was brushed off by the pundits as being just another crazy Trump Cabinet member.  Hardly.  Sec Rubio was telegraphing the plan in not so direct words.  

So now that we have the controlling agreement over Greenland, we iced out CCP and Russia AND NATO.  Greenland was always the key to our future defense plans for our homeland.  Now we have it.  Understand this is not a NATO agreement.  It is separate and only involves us, Denmark and Greenlanders.

What does this all mean?  It means now our threats of leaving NATO will be taken seriously by the other member nations.  The US is no longer tied to them, blasting apart the 1951 NATO Greenland agreement was the key.  Trump just broke it.  Now we can leave, the other member nations know this and they are in a panic.  Trump holds all the cards now.

Stay tuned for more....
